title: A non-pediocin low molecular weight antimicrobial peptide produced by Pediococcus pentosaceus strain IE-3 shows increased activity under reducing environment.
A non-pediocin low molecular weight antimicrobial peptide produced by Pediococcus pentosaceus strain IE-3 shows increased activity under reducing environment.
A non-pediocin low molecular weight antimicrobial peptide produced by Pediococcus pentosaceus strain IE-3 shows increased activity under reducing environment.

comments_text: The cell-free fermented broth was active against both Gram+ and Gram- bacteria. The purified peptide was active against M. luteus (MIC 6.3 uM), V. cholera (MIC 25.4 uM). However, the reduced form of this peptide was found to be more active and M. luteus, L. monocytogenes, and V. cholera were most sensitive.The structure was predicted as a 2-stranded beta-sheet. Reg. 9/2014.
title: A non-pediocin low molecular weight antimicrobial peptide produced by Pediococcus pentosaceus strain IE-3 shows increased activity under reducing environment

comments_text: Unlike pediocin-like bacteriocins, the low molecular weight peptide (LMW) showed resistance to different proteases. Moreover, peptide treated with reducing agent like dithiothreitol (DTT) exhibited increased activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative test strains in comparison to native peptide. However, peptide treated with oxidizing agent such as hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) did not show any antimicrobial activity.
hemolytic_activity_text: No hemolysis information or data found in the reference(s) presented in this entry
